verdict: Leads surging and cost per lead is holding — but key setup work is overdue.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 95 leads from Meta at $5.23 per lead, and the most recent 7 days brought a strong surge — leads more than doubled compared to the prior 7-day period. That momentum is real, though cost per lead crept up 16% as spend increased sharply, so we're monitoring efficiency closely as volume scales. The more pressing issue is that 9 planned milestones — covering landing pages, CRM setup, search campaigns, and lead nurture sequences — remain undelivered, some by as much as 55 days, which means we cannot yet verify where leads go after they arrive or follow up on them automatically. Delivery of those items is the active priority this week, and completing them is what unlocks the full picture heading into Phase 1 close at month-end.
